body: CHANGELOG updated in PRRJECT_FATBABY: feat(eventstore): Phase 0 of the replay-fragility fix — streaming Scan(ctx, fromSeq, fn) API on eventstore.FileStore replaces the O(n`)^2`) ReadFrom read path (was re-reading and re-JSON-decoding the entire journal file per 512-record page; the 354MB 2026-07-16 journal took ~39 full passes). Migrated signalindex.Build/Tail, docindex.Build/Tail, and entity-graph's buildFilingIndexes onto Scan; ReadFrom untouched for targeted single-record fetches. Added -replay-from-seq emergency degraded-mode flag to signalapi/newssite per the northstar's §5. Also fixed Tail()'s first poll waiting a full pollInterval (default 30s) before signaling ready, in both signalindex and docindex — was masked by the O(n^2) bug, became the dominant cost once that was fixed. Live-verified against the real var/secwatch store (630MB/116K records): signalapi cold rebuild was previously unable to complete (killed twice at 628MB/540MB RSS with swap near-exhausted); now completes in 30.1s wall-clock at 60.6MB peak RSS (northstar acceptance target: <60s, <300MB). 5 new eventstore tests for Scan (ReadFrom-equivalence, tail-resume-without-reprocessing, no-op-on-no-new-events, truncated-trailing-line tolerance, fn-error-stops-scan). go test ./... green. Phases 1-3 (SQLite checkpoints, entity-graph incremental tables) remain per docs/northstar/replay-fragility.md.
